notes: Interface facts only: subject/command names, option names with their declared argument type, syntax shapes, stored-result names, and the one-line functional title of each help file. No help paragraphs, examples or option descriptions are copied.

When several help files document the same subject, the file named after the subject provides 'help' and its facts; the other files are listed in 'help_files' and are not mixed in, so that a superseded syntax never passes for the current one.
Option 'type' is the argument kind named by the help file (numeric, string, integer, namelist, varlist, ...) and is null when the file does not state one.

The whole corpus fits in about 1.3 MB, so no per-file detail was dropped: every subject keeps its help path, title, family, syntax, options and stored results. The per-file section list that parse_help returns is not stored in the document.
Subjects are the names the help files document, which includes help topics (postestimation pages, option glossaries, prefix variants) and not only executable commands.
